newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Global Marine estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Global Marine estimate cut.

text.p: -- Hanifen Imhoff Inc said Tuesday it lowered its earnings estimate for Global Marine Inc in the first quarter to $0.26 a share from $0.27 a share.

-- Hanifen said the move reflects weather delays and rig scarcity in the Gulf of Mexico, which would affect the drilling contractor's operations. Global Marine has drilled 25 turnkey wells in the Gulf so far this year, only one of which has not been profitable, Hanifen said.
-- The estimate of $1.45 a share for all of 1997 was left unchanged, Hanifen said.
-- Global Marine is an international drilling contractor.
-- Its shares were trading off 3/8 Tuesday at 21.
